question: How does VGG initialize deeper configurations from configuration A, and how does this differ from the per-layer weight initialization reported in DCNN?

gold_evidence.quote: we initialised the ﬁrst four convolutional layers

question: How do DCNN and VGG distribute training across multiple GPUs, and how do the GPUs exchange information in each scheme?

gold_evidence.quote: puts half of the kernels (or neurons) on each GPU
Multi-GPU training exploits data parallelism

reference_points: DCNN places roughly half the kernels/neurons on each of two GPUs; communication is restricted to selected layers (layer 3 sees both GPUs, layer 4 only its own).
VGG uses data parallelism by splitting each image batch into GPU batches.
VGG synchronously averages GPU gradients to obtain the full-batch gradient, equivalent to the single-GPU computation.
novelty_vs_previous_46: Parallelization and synchronization; no previous question asked model versus data parallelism.
